notes: S4.1 states that reg0 and reg1 retain their previous values whenever no valid write occurs, but it omits the synchronous reset exception. A sampled high rst has highest priority and clears both registers even when no valid write occurs. S3.1 correctly specifies reset priority and the final RTL implements it correctly, so the error is introduced when the transition semantics are generalized into the S4.1 candidate property. Final RTL passes all trusted simulation and bounded formal obligations.
